description:
We are looking for Sharepoint Developer in Columbia, SC for 11+ months contract position.  
 
 Please refer someone else if you are not available at this time or you are not right match for this job opportunity. We have great Referral Bonus up to $2500!!! Please don't miss to refer someone who are looking for projects. 
 
 
 Job Description: 
 Position: Sharepoint Developer 
 Location: Columbia, SC 29201 
 Duration: 11+ months 
 Client: Direct Client 
 
 Specific responsibilities include but not limited to: 
 • Set up and configure SharePoint Services on servers. 
 • Maintain web front-end servers and some aspects of database. 
 • Assist with creating and maintaining sites, site collections, applications, web parts, features, themes, workflows, navigation and master pages. 
 • Assist with design, develop, and implement InfoPath forms and workflows to improve business process 
 • Provide documentation and training to customers on new functionality and custom solutions. 
 • Assist with site customization using SharePoint Designer. 
 • Follow DIS and EPO standards when developing solutions 
 • Deploy and administer SharePoint portals. 
 • Assist with establishing and maintaining end-user access policy and permissions. This may include delegating permissions authority to other users. 
 • All sites and site collections security should be implemented using Active Directory security. 
 • Develop and maintain system documentation to include Site names, site collection and site owners 
 • Review and recommend the needed Office 365 SharePoint controls in order to maintain the security of the sites 
 • Strong ASP.NET Web Forms Development [Web Parts, Custom ASPX Pages, etc.] 
 • Knowledge of XML [Features, Content Types, Field Definitions] 
 • Working knowledge in JavaScript [jQuery, SPServices, REST, Custom Field Types, etc.] 
 • Strong working knowledge of PowerShell 
 • Ability to write/debug CAML (Collaborative Application Markup Language) queries 
 • Working knowledge of the SharePoint app model 
 
 REQUIRED EDUCATION: 
 BACHELOR’S DEGREE OR EQUIVALENT WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
 REQUIRED SKILLS : 
 • 5+ YEARS with Microsoft SharePoint administration with at least 1 year using Office 365. 
 • EXPERIENCE IN MICROSOFT SQL SERVER 2008/2012/2014/2016. 
 • EXPERIENCE EXTRACTING REPORTS FORM SHAREPOINT 
 • 3 + YEARS CREATING AND MAINTAINING INFOPATH FORMS. 
 • EXCELLENT TROUBLESHOOTING SKILLS TO ROOT CAUSE COMPLEX ISSUES. 
 • HAVE THE ABILITY TO EXAMINE AND QUICKLY LEARN EXISTING BUSINESS LOGIC AND PROCESSES. 
 • EXCELLENT COMMUNICATION SKILLS BOTH VERBALLY AND IN WRITTEN FORM. 
 • EXCELLENT ANALYTICAL, PROBLEM SOLVING, AND CODE-READING SKILLS. 
 • MUST BE A SELF-STARTING TEAM PLAYER, AND HAVE THE ABILITY TO PERFORM WELL IN A FAST-PACED, DEADLINE-DRIVEN ENVIRONMENT. 
 • ABILITY TO RE-MEDIATE SECURITY ISSUES WITHIN DEVELOPED APPLICATION CODE 
 • KNOWLEDGE OF BEST PRACTICES IN WEB DESIGN 
 • ABILITY TO TEACH, TRAIN, AND TRANSFER KNOWLEDGE. 
 
 PREFERRED SKILLS: 
 • EXPERIENCE WITH VISUAL STUDIO, C#, ASP.NET IS A PLUS. 
 • EXPERIENCE WITH TEAM FOUNDATION IS A PLUS. 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
